value.text: Preschool swim registration for Ada opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7:00 p.m. Eastern. I saw two sessions: Sat 9:00 and Sun 10:00, $98 each. On this town's site you submit and pay yourself. I'd join the open, fill in the registration, and text you the open browser to check and finish. Which sessions do you want, in order? One heads-up: if you also queue on your own phone or computer, you'd hold two places in line, and the town's queue counts that as more than one.
